description: This PHP source file defines the EcsCredentialProvider class, which fetches container credentials from AWS ECS using HTTP requests, handling environment variables, request construction, retries, and credential decoding.

classes.name: EcsCredentialProvider
classes.description: Credential provider class that retrieves AWS ECS container credentials via HTTP GET requests, with support for environment variables, retries, and credential decoding.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the provider with optional configuration for timeout, retries, and HTTP client.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Loads container credentials asynchronously, handling retries and credential parsing.

methods.name: getAttempts
methods.description: Returns the number of credential retrieval attempts made.

methods.name: getEcsAuthToken
methods.description: Retrieves the ECS authorization token from environment variables or token file.

methods.name: getHeadersForAuthToken
methods.description: Prepares HTTP headers with the authorization token for credential requests.

methods.name: setHeaderForAuthToken
methods.description: Deprecated method to set headers with auth token.

methods.name: getEcsUri
methods.description: Constructs the URI for ECS credential metadata based on environment variables.

methods.name: decodeResult
methods.description: Decodes the JSON response containing credentials and validates required fields.

methods.name: isCompatibleUri
methods.description: Checks if the given URI is a valid container credential request URI based on scheme and host.
